title: Safe runs define access paths
statement: For either access mode, let $c$ be a configuration on input $y$, and let $T$ be a natural number. If every configuration at times $t<T$ in the run of the access program from $c$ has each work head between $-1$ and the length of the binary representation of $|y|+1$, inclusive, then the run from $c$ to time $T$ is an access path. Here an access path is a finite sequence of zero or more program steps, with each step allowed when its starting configuration satisfies that same head-position bound.
